summary: TaskBoard does what a single person needs: add, complete, filter and export tasks, with good automated tests and accessibility. It does not yet do what its name promises: the board is not shared, and the admin role controls nothing because anyone can pick it.
The fix is contained. A small server for storing tasks, settings and accounts turns it into a real team board without rewriting the interface.

commitment: Every finding in this report points to the exact place in the code or data that shows it. Before any change, we record the current behaviour as tests, so nothing that works today breaks unnoticed.
